# "<Series title>" — series contract

The binding rules for every article and every run of this series. Change them only on purpose,
with a dated note at the end. The full contracts of the existing series
(`docs/seri/SOZLESME.md`, `docs/seri-guvenlik/SOZLESME.md`) show what each section can hold.

## 1. Identity
Title, key, routes, content paths, audience, planned length.

## 2. Editorial rules
Length band, required sections (for example a closing self-check and `## Kaynakça`), voice,
what the checker enforces (`tools/series/check-series-content.cjs`).

## 3. Sources and claims
Which sources count, how they are cited (author, year, title, venue, link, access date),
how numbers are reported (with the model and condition they were measured under).

## 4. Figures
When a figure earns its place, `assets/<slug>/*.svg`, alt text that states the figure's claim.

## 5. Runs
Batch size, gates to pass, what the agent may and may not do (no commit, push or deploy),
how corrections are marked.

## Change notes
- <date>: created.
